invariants.rationale: Average bytes per record, representing a size estimate, should not be negative regardless of estimation method or error.
If no commit meets the threshold criteria, the default estimate is returned; otherwise, result comes from a commit's record size estimation.
If the timeline is empty, only the config estimate is used as no commits can provide an alternate value.
Returned average is unlikely to exceed the configured small file limit, which is closely associated with average record sizing thresholds.
The estimated average should never exceed the sum of the configured defaults and limits for file sizes.
